integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic computations corroborate the proof but do not prove the unbounded theorem. The asserted proof uses geometric identifications of the original paper, torus-localization and ordered-root topology. No independent mathematical audit.

title: Euler profiles and monodromy of extended-Dynkin Fano forgetful fibrations
